product_family: Email and data security platform with AI-powered behavioral detection. Products include Tessian Guardian (accidental data loss prevention), Tessian Enforcer (insider threat and exfiltration prevention), Proofpoint Email Security, AI Security, and Data Security & Governance solutions.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Proofpoint maintains a robust security posture with a public Trust Center and verified SOC 2 Type II compliance. Available for Proofpoint Core Email Protection SEG/API, Proofpoint Prime, Proofpoint Combined SaaS Solutions (Legacy Tessian and Normalyze).

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001 - Information security management system certification providing 'a comprehensive framework to establish, implement, and maintain controls' for data protection.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 42001 - 'Artificial Intelligence management system (AIMS)' certification for responsible AI development and monitoring.

certifications.name: FedRAMP Authorization
certifications.proof_quote: FedRAMP Authorization - Cloud products meet federal security standards; details available at the FedRAMP Marketplace.

certifications.name: IRAP (Australian Government)
certifications.proof_quote: IRAP - Australian Government certification aligned with the Information Security Manual (ISM) requirements.

certifications.name: National Security Framework (ENS) - Spain
certifications.proof_quote: National Security Framework (ENS) - Spain's framework certification for information systems supporting identified services.

certifications.name: Data Privacy Framework Certification
certifications.proof_quote: Data Privacy Framework Certification - Complies with EU-U.S., UK Extension, and Swiss-U.S. frameworks per dataprivacyframework.gov.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: PCI Compliant - Proofpoint Archive meets PCI standards.

certifications.name: FIPS Certification
certifications.proof_quote: FIPS Certification - 'Federal Information Protection Standard (FIPS) certification and validation' for cryptographic modules.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Registry
certifications.proof_quote: STAR Registry - Listed on the Cloud Security Alliance's Security, Trust, Assurance, and Risk registry.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Proofpoint's global operations adhere to GDPR with Global DPA available in a variety of languages. GDPR compliance is fundamental to their data processing model.

certifications.name: HIPAA Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Proofpoint offers HIPAA-compliant products and can enter Business Associate Agreements. However, no formal HIPAA certification (e.g., HITRUST) or public BAA template is documented. Proofpoint states 'Proofpoint applies the minimum necessary concept required by HIPAA' and commits to protecting Protected Health Information (PHI) for up to 18 months.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Security Controls)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Proofpoint's vendor domain or trust center pages.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (Cloud PII Protection)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Proofpoint's vendor domain or trust center pages.

certifications.name: ISO 27701 (Privacy Information Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Proofpoint's vendor domain or trust center pages.

privacy.ai_training_note: Proofpoint explicitly states: 'We do not use customer data to train any generative LLMs.' However, they do use definitively identified malicious messages to train classical machine learning models (not generative) for threat detection, and aggregated threat analytics without identifying customer content. No customer opt-out mechanism is documented for threat intelligence training.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region with data processing in North America (AWS, Google Cloud, co-location facilities) and Europe (EU co-location facilities). Specific residency options available upon request.

security.name: Information Security Program
security.value: Documented information security program aligning with NIST 800-53 and ISO 27001 requirements, with continuous monthly/quarterly monitoring and annual SOC 2 Type II audit.

security.name: Subprocessor Transparency
security.value: Published list of third-party service providers and subprocessors by location

security.name: Data Retention Policy
security.value: Product-specific data retention policies documented; HIPAA-scope data retained up to 18 months post-agreement then destroyed

products.name: Tessian Guardian
products.data_scope: Outbound email content, recipient analysis, file attachments
products.notes: AI-powered accidental data loss prevention using behavioral detection. Integrates with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. GDPR/CCPA compliant.

products.name: Tessian Enforcer
products.data_scope: Email content analysis, user behavior patterns, file access logs
products.notes: Advanced machine learning prevents malicious insider threats and sophisticated data exfiltration. No pre-defined rules required.

products.name: Proofpoint Email Security (Core)
products.data_scope: Email headers, message content, attachment metadata
products.notes: Leader in Gartner Magic Quadrant for Email Security 2025. Blocks 95M BEC attacks annually.

products.name: Proofpoint AI Security
products.data_scope: LLM interactions, prompt history, data access logs
products.notes: Controls how LLMs and AI agents access and share data. Prevents prompt-based attacks and data leaks. Does not train generative models on customer data.

products.name: Proofpoint Data Security & Governance
products.data_scope: Sensitive data discovery, access patterns, usage monitoring
products.notes: Unified platform for data protection and compliance across storage, access, and usage. Supports GDPR, CCPA, and healthcare regulations.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription, per-user or per-email basis. Enterprise licensing available.
compare.data_residency: Multi-region (North America primary, Europe available). No on-premises deployment option.

flags: Proofpoint does not hold a formal HIPAA certification (e.g., HITRUST). It offers HIPAA-compliant products and can execute BAAs, but no public Business Associate Agreement template or HIPAA compliance certification is documented. Healthcare customers should verify BAA availability during procurement.

Cloud Provider Certifications: Proofpoint's infrastructure leverages AWS, Google Cloud, and co-location providers that maintain their own SOC 2/ISO 27001 certifications. These are the cloud provider's certs, not Proofpoint's direct responsibility, though Proofpoint relies on them.

AI Training Transparency: While Proofpoint does not train generative LLMs on customer data, they do use malicious message samples and aggregated threat analytics for classical ML model training. No customer opt-out mechanism is documented for this threat intelligence training, which may be a concern for some regulated sectors.
